name: A · 张扬妩媚
detail: Preserve confident sly smile, wavy high ponytail, red asymmetric fitted wrap top, black waist, broad red long side panels, dark riding trousers, low-held crescent dao and hand on hip. Strong elegant S-curve silhouette.
prompt: Use case: style-transfer and precise character redesign. Produce ONE full-body standalone Chinese wuxia female dao fighter, clearly an ADULT woman. Image1 is the target candidate: preserve her individual identity, personality, outfit cut, feminine bust-waist-hip curves, weapon identity and pose idea. Image2 is AUTHORITATIVE for compact game-character proportions, stylized eyes and outline/shading. Image3 is gem-icon painting style. Redraw the whole figure to unify with image2: visibly larger head, short neck, compact torso and MUCH SHORTER legs, about 3.5 head heights crown-to-sole (not counting ponytail). Keep an adult woman's face and mature soft curvy physique; never a child. Do not retain the 6-7 head tall anime fashion proportions from image1. Keep curving feminine silhouette, avoid muscular pectoral anatomy or hard polygonal skin. Bold consistent dark contour; large coherent colored planes, only 2-3 purposeful shadow shapes per material; a few broad bevel highlights. No noisy tiny triangles, no fragmented folds or hair strands, no realistic eyes. Chinese costume design, red color accents only with black, ivory, muted gold/silver neutrals. Sparse large ornament; clear shape rhythm. Three-quarter view facing SCREEN LEFT. Preserve confident sly smile, wavy high ponytail, red asymmetric fitted wrap top, black waist, broad red long side panels, dark riding trousers, low-held crescent dao and hand on hip. Strong elegant S-curve silhouette. Entire head, weapon tips and feet inside square canvas with generous 8% margin. Warm ivory plain background, no floor shadow, no lettering, no panel, no extra figures. The output must look from the SAME compact stylized RPG roster as image2, with gem-icon graphic clarity.
